guidelines.detail: documentation rule FID-01 not applied (The description says the prototype undergoes tests to assess its functionality, while the reference task for testing functionality has no counterpart in the generated model. FID-01 already directs modeling every distinct activity stated in the description.)

refines GW-01 (The description gives approval and discard as alternative outcomes, and the missing flows show that neither outcome branch was modeled. GW-01 already calls for identifying gateway behavior; this guideline specifies how to model mutually exclusive outcome branches.)

same as LRN-015 (The description lists functionality, safety, and market potential as testing objectives, while the generated label preserves them and the reference label narrows the activity to safety alone. This is already covered by learned guideline LRN-015.)

same as LRN-004 (The description identifies multiple assessment areas, while the records show that branches for distinct evaluations were missing. The learned guideline LRN-004 already gives essentially this modeling instruction.)

same as LRN-015 (The description names three testing objectives, while the reference label retains only one; the generated label preserves all three. The records support the general guideline, which is already stated in learned guideline LRN-015.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: Model every distinct activity, event, participant, decision, branch, loop, message and outcome stated in the description. Do not invent process facts.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that an item is tested or assessed to evaluate one or more properties

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description explicitly lists multiple objectives or criteria that an activity is meant to address: Preserve the stated objectives or criteria in the BPMN task label rather than narrowing the label to only one of them.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description explicitly lists multiple objectives or criteria that an activity is meant to address

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that a process can end with one of several mutually exclusive outcomes: Model the choice with an exclusive gateway and connect each outgoing branch to the activity or end event corresponding to that outcome.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that a process can end with one of several mutually exclusive outcomes

rules_sent_back.instruction: When When a description names multiple distinct activities within one phase and states that the process continues only after every activity is finished,: model the activities as parallel branches with a parallel split and join, rather than as a sequence.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description names multiple distinct evaluations that must all be completed before a shared next step
